theorems.name: Submission.regcomp_ims_overlap_orient_eq_or_neg
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R₁ R₂ : IMRep U n), (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R₁.carrier ∩ R₂.carrier)), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n R₁.carrier x Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (R₁.carrier ∩ R₂.carrier) x Q) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R₁.carrier ∩ R₂.carrier)), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n R₂.carrier x Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (R₁.carrier ∩ R₂.carrier) x Q) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R₁.carrier ∩ R₂.carrier)), R₂.orient x = R₁.orient x ∨ R₂.orient x = -R₁.orient x
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
